sermon.title: A Closer Look at Disciples
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer adds a sixth attribute of the apostles—they were sent, including to make disciples. A disciple learns and obeys God’s word, is baptized and can be filled with the Spirit. Through Stephen, Ananias, Dorcas, the Antioch believers and young Timothy he shows that ordinary disciples with character, understanding and the Spirit were used powerfully, and that God can change America through serving disciples.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Acts 9:10 spoken as “9:17”; 1 Thessalonians 3:2 spoken as “2:18”; Timothy’s father called an atheist; Eusebius said to be a secular historian; the first Roman army defeated in the Jewish revolt; the New Testament church gave alms only to believers. Sensitive content kept as spoken: churches teaching baptism unnecessary; pre-tribulation rapture rejected; children who died when parents refused medicine; summer camp children talking about suicide; half of homes divorced and dysfunctional; churches putting youth in ministry “fools.”

But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. And as you go, preach, saying, ‘The kingdom of heaven is at hand.’ Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons. scriptures.text_nkjv: At Joppa there was a certain disciple named Tabitha, which is translated Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and charitable deeds which she did. faqs.question: Is every believer sent like the apostles?
faqs.answer: He says not necessarily every believer.

faqs.question: Must a disciple be baptized?
faqs.answer: He says you are not a disciple if you are not baptized.

faqs.question: What is a disciple?
faqs.answer: One who learns and obeys God’s word.

faqs.question: Were all 120 filled at Pentecost apostles?
Are gifts worthless without fruit?
faqs.answer: Yes, he says gifts without the fruit are worthless.

faqs.question: Is taking medicine unbelief?
faqs.answer: No—those who are sick need a physician.

faqs.question: Should Christians ever flee persecution?
faqs.answer: He says there’s a time to run, as Jesus taught.

faqs.question: Should young people be put in ministry?
faqs.answer: Not as novices; they should first be examples.

faqs.question: How can America be healed?
faqs.answer: The church must humble itself, pray and turn.
